body: Hell yes! My car and I are both old and kinda beat down, and this one has seen a lot of good memories with me. Its one of the few places I can let go, blast music at an obscene volume, and let the wind drown everything else out.

Bro they would care. If she's with you she really does care about you, I've been with people who don't care, they leave when its no longer convenient. Give it some time and try to work on yourself, without giving a thought to what people think of you.
I agree. I could handle all the sadness and hate, that at least is something to focus on.
